pr_title: bluetooth: mesh: cfg_cli: Check buf len when pullng out data
pr_body:
This commit checks that tconfig client doesn't pull out data outside of the buffer.

Fixes #80012

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: Shell: User input validation
comments: I took a quick look at `cfg_cli.c`, and there seems to be similar checks missing in other places too (e.g. `bt_mesh_comp_p1_item_pull()`).

review_comments: Since there are a multiple places to leave function without success, it will be nice to understand which one has been triggered. Could you add `LOG_DBG` in all not succeeded returns?
